title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 18: the potter's house, clay in Yahweh's hand, a nation that turns from evil, and plots against Jeremiah.

questions.text: Where was Jeremiah told to go to hear Yahweh's words?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear my words."

answers.text: To the king's palace
To the potter's house
To the valley of Hinnom
To the gate of the temple

questions.text: What did the potter do when the vessel he was making was marred in his hand?
questions.explanation: When the vessel of clay was marred in the potter's hand, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

answers.text: He threw the marred clay away
He broke it in pieces on the ground
He left the wheel and went out of the house
He made it again into another vessel

questions.text: What does Yahweh say the house of Israel is in His hand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Behold, as the clay in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel."

answers.text: As the clay in the potter's hand
As a sword in the warrior's hand
As an arrow in the archer's hand
As a seal on his right hand

questions.text: What will Yahweh do if a nation He has spoken against turns from its evil?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that if that nation turns from their evil, He will repent of the evil that He thought to do to them.

answers.text: He will test them for seven years
He will delay the evil one generation
He will repent of the evil He thought to do to them
He will make them rulers over other nations

questions.text: How do the people answer the call to return from their evil ways?
questions.explanation: They say, "It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart."

answers.text: "It is in vain; we will walk after our own plans"
"We will return, for Yahweh is merciful"
"Let the prophet first show us a sign"
"We have not sinned against Yahweh"

questions.text: What does Yahweh ask about the snow of Lebanon?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks, "Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?"

answers.text: Whether it will cover the sins of the people
Whether it will fail from the rock of the field
Whether it will melt before the fire of His anger
Whether it will fall on the cities of Judah

questions.text: What have Yahweh's people done, so that they stumble in their ways?
questions.explanation: The text says, "My people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods," and have been made to stumble in the ancient paths.

answers.text: They have sold their inheritance for silver
They have sworn oaths by the king of Babylon
They have despised the elders at the gate
They have forgotten Him and burned incense to false gods

questions.text: What will Yahweh show them in the day of their calamity?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity."

answers.text: His outstretched arm
His burning anger
The back, and not the face
The armies of the north

questions.text: How do Jeremiah's enemies plan to attack him when they devise plans against him?
questions.explanation: They say, "Come, and let's strike him with the tongue, and let's not give heed to any of his words."

answers.text: With stones at the gate
With the tongue, ignoring his words
With a letter to the king
With false witnesses in court

questions.text: What does Jeremiah say his enemies have dug for his soul?
questions.explanation: He asks, "Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul," though he stood before Yahweh to speak good for them.

answers.text: A pit
A grave
A well without water
A trench of fire
